messages:
Kira: Quick flag  - compact top toolbar on the deployments page has multiple small UX/a11y nits at 380px. Icon buttons are touching and tooltips overlap the search input. Screenshot attached.
Omar: Saw it. Two problems: hit areas are inconsistent and the tooltip stacking context is wrong (tooltips get clipped by header overflow).
Lucie: Proposal: standardize to a responsive hit token (we call it `touch-hit`) that resolves to 44px on small screens and 36px on desktop dense. Keeps one token but responsive.
Kira: Yes please. Also the view toggle tooltip currently reads "Toggle" which is ambiguous. Suggest "Toggle view: List / Compact".
Renee: Accessibility: ensure icon buttons have aria-labels and the grouped controls use role="toolbar" with aria-orientation. For the collapsed state, announce "Toolbar collapsed" via sr-only text when menu is triggered.
Omar: For clipping: move tooltip/menu portals to the global portal root (`#redwood-portal`) so they escape container overflow. If a component absolutely needs local clipping, add a prop to opt-in.
Lucie: Small CSS example for hit area:
```
.icon-btn { --hit: var(--token-touch-hit); padding: calc((var(--hit) - var(--icon-size)) / 2); }
```
Kira: Nice. Also reduced-motion: disable the tooltip slide for users who prefer reduced motion. Tiny rule is enough.
DevBot: FYI: existing token `space-10` maps to 44px in tokens.json. Consider creating `touch-hit` as an alias to keep docs discoverable.
Renee: When we add alias, include a note: "responsive token - 44px mobile / 36px desktop". And add a11y tests for keyboard nav + screen reader announcements.
Omar: I'll open a small PR to: 1) add `touch-hit` alias, 2) portal tooltips/menus to global root, 3) update tooltip copy. Will include visual diffs at 360/380/1024.
Lucie: I'll run keyboard walkthrough and VoiceOver checks once the PR is up.
Kira: Owners: Omar (PR), Lucie (a11y), Renee (copy tweak + docs). Ping here with staging link. :thumbsup:
